vb_textbox.text: To be successful in this task, you need to be alert throughout the task, for the full duration of it. This is because you need to promptly act when you see the figures on the screen and choose one quickly. Then you need to press the spacebar, again promptly to see how many mushrooms have been collected in the field. Sometimes however, you may not have any mushrooms in the field available to collect and put in your basket. If you do not react quick enough when the figures appear on the screen, they disappear and a different screen appears.
